observations: Photo 0 shows a metal gearbox-style unit with a worm-gear style housing and an output shaft flange with four bolt holes.
No electric motor is attached in the photo; only the reduction gear housing is visible.
No brand name, model number, or serial plate is legible anywhere in the image.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'STEVE INDUSTRIAL' overlay the image; these are the lister's marketing watermark, not proof of condition.
Surface shows normal machined/cast aluminum finish with some light oxidation/staining, consistent with a used industrial part.
No input shaft or coupling to a motor is visible, so it is unclear if a motor is included or sold separately.
Seller's new reply is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo, video, or document was provided.

identity.kind: worm-gear motor speed reducer (gearbox only, no motor visible)

claims.claim: This is a motor speed reducer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a gearbox housing consistent with a worm-drive reducer, but no motor is attached and no label confirms its exact function or ratio.
No import documentation, shipping label, or country-of-origin marking visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Tested and working (reaffirmed: 'I tested it myself yesterday')
claims.evidence: Still only a verbal claim; no video, sound clip, or power-on demonstration provided. A seller's restated assurance is not visual proof.
This is an audio/operational claim; no audio or video evidence given.
'Mileage' is not a meaningful metric for a gear reducer; no usage log or hour-meter shown.
No close-up of casing bolts/seals to show they are factory-sealed or untouched; photo angle doesn't show housing seams clearly.

risks.risk: Internal gear/bearing wear or damage not visible from outside
risks.proof: A video of the unit running under load, or a photo with the housing opened showing gear teeth condition

risks.risk: Output shaft or seal damage (leaks, play, corrosion) not clearly visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of shaft and seal area, and a hand-turn test video

risks.risk: Unknown gear ratio and size/model, which affects compatibility and value
risks.proof: Clear photo of any stamped ratio/model code on the housing or a legible nameplate

risks.risk: No motor included despite 'motor speed reducer' phrasing, creating ambiguity about what's being sold
risks.proof: Photo showing the full assembly with motor attached, or seller confirmation with a photo of the motor unit

risks.risk: Possible corrosion or internal rust from storage/shipping (common with 'tokunbo' imports)
risks.proof: Photo of the input/output shaft interior and any drain/fill plug removed
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential internal corrosion

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any nameplate, stamped model number, or ratio marking on the housing
Video of the unit powered and running (or at least the shaft turning freely by hand) to support 'tested and working'
Photo showing whether a motor is included, and if so, its nameplate
Close-up of the housing seams/bolts to support 'never opened' claim
Photo of output shaft and seal area for wear/leak assessment
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not change the evidence on record; the claims remain unverified and the item must still be priced at worst case as an unbranded, unproven-working gearbox with no motor confirmed included.
